entries.title: A crewmate shows what its background work waits on
entries.body: A crewmate waiting on a background command it started now rests dimmed inside a dashed ring, in orange, because the work is still running on your computer. A crewmate waiting on its checks rests in the same ring in blue, because the wait is outside. The dashes keep both apart from the full ring of a crewmate waiting on you, and the Tasks list marks each row the same way.

picture.alt: The crew around Firstmate: an orange crewmate and a blue crewmate, each resting dimmed inside a dashed ring
